messages:
Claire: Quick kickoff  planning a short-form launch for the OSS refapp next month. Need: concise launch post, 2 micro-bench stats for social, a 30-min demo webinar, and inbound routing for signups. Who takes what?
Ben: I can do the bench numbers + 1-slide visual. Goal: one cost stat and one latency stat that fit in a tweet. Will run baseline vs cache+batching.
Rosa: I'll draft the launch post and two email variants (dev & platform). Suggest CTA test: Try the repo vs See benchmarks.
Miguel: I'll build the registration form and wiring. Plan: form -> HubSpot list "oss-refapp-mini"; routing: company_size >=100 -> AE, 20-99 -> SDR, <20 -> automated trial. Will tag source=openref-mini.
Claire: Good. Keep cohort size = 80 for interactivity, and reserve 5 office hours slots for enterprise signups.
Ben: Bench plan: run 100 x 512-token conversational prompts. Expect ~20% p95 improvement with cache on; will confirm. I'll push images to /assets/mini_bench_cost.png and /assets/mini_bench_latency.png.
Rosa: Post draft idea: short hero, 3 bullets on what you get (repo, tutorial, perf checklist), and clear how-to-run locally. I'll include the 1-command deploy snippet.
Miguel: Form fields: name, email, company, role, company_size, interest (try/demo/pilot). Webhook ready at /hooks/hubspot-openref-mini.
Claire: Measurement: track form submits, attendee rate, repo clones, and demo requests. Add UTM tags.
Rosa: Will A/B header for social: A) "Deploy a refapp in 30 minutes" B) "Cut inference cost & latency".
Ben: I'll prepare two one-line bench blurbs that map to those headlines.
Miguel: Also adding Slack notification to #sales-inbound when company_size >= 500.
ops-bot: Event created: "Mini Demo: OSS Refapp Quickstart" -> https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3624500123.
Claire: Assign owners: Ben = benches & assets, Rosa = copy & emails, Miguel = form & routing. I'll coordinate publish timing (teaser 7d, launch day, follow-up +3d).
content-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Publish teaser social" 7 days before event.
Rosa: I'll post the first draft here tomorrow. Ben  drop the bench PNGs when ready. Miguel  share the live form link.
Ben: Will upload assets by EOD tomorrow.
Miguel: Form WIP: https://forms.redwood.com/openref-mini (WIP)
Claire: Thanks team  keep updates short here so we capture decisions. Closing thread for now. :sparkles:
